```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "TC and line-reg failures come from self-cascode bottom devices sitting at the triode edge (Vds≈Vdsat, M2a in triode), so mirror and ΔVbe accuracy depend on supply. Raise top/bottom strength ratio to ~60 to push bottom Vds above 4·UT, and model it."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wp": (8.0, 3.0, 30.0),      # PMOS self-cascode bottom W
    "Lp": (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),     # PMOS bottom L
    "Wn": (4.0, 1.5, 20.0),      # NMOS self-cascode bottom W
    "Ln": (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),     # NMOS bottom L
    "rsc": (60.0, 25.0, 150.0),  # self-cascode strength ratio (W/L)top/(W/L)bot
    "R1": (270e3, 120e3, 800e3), # PTAT resistor: I = UT ln8 / R1
    "R2": (3.0e6, 1.2e6, 8e6),   # PTAT gain resistor in Q3 branch
    "Rd": (8.0e6, 3e6, 20e6),    # divider total
    "kb": (0.735, 0.6, 0.85),    # Rb/Rd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N1, N2 = 2, 16
    N = N2 / N1
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]
    rsc = p["rsc"]
    Lt = 1.0
    Wpt = max(0.42, rsc * Wp / Lp * Lt)
    Wnt = max(0.42, rsc * Wn / Ln * Lt)
    R1, R2, Rd = p["R1"], p["R2"], p["Rd"]
    Rb = p["kb"] * Rd
    Ra = Rd - Rb

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.M("M3a", "p3", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M3b", "pg", "pg", "p3", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M4a", "p4", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4b", "ng", "pg", "p4", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M5a", "p5", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M5b", "vbg", "pg", "p5", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M1b", "ng", "ng", "n1", "vss", "nfet", Wnt, Lt)
    n.M("M1a", "n1", "ng", "e1", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("M2b", "pg", "ng", "n2", "vss", "nfet", Wnt, Lt)
    n.M("M2a", "n2", "ng", "e2", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=N1)
    n.R("R1", "e2", "eq2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eq2", m=N2)
    n.R("R2", "vbg", "eq3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "eq3", m=1)
    n.R("Ra", "vbg", "vref", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    # start-up
    n.M("Mpu1", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu2", "s2", "vss", "s1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu3", "x", "vss", "s2", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Msd", "x", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)

    # ---------- predictions ----------
    k_q = 8.617e-5
    T0 = 300.15
    Vg0, xti = 1.17, 3.0
    def veb(I, m, T):
        i_u = max(I / m, 1e-12)
        ut = k_q * T
        v0 = 0.76 + k_q * T0 * math.log(i_u / 10e-6)
        return Vg0 - (Vg0 - v0) * T / T0 - (xti - 1) * ut * math.log(T / T0)

    def outv(T):
        ut = k_q * T
        I = ut * math.log(N) / R1
        ie3 = 0.5 * I
        vbg = 0.0
        for _ in range(40):
            vb = veb(ie3, 1, T)
            vbg = (I * R2 + vb) * Rd / (R2 + Rd)
            ie3 = max(I - vbg / Rd, 1e-12)
        return vbg * Rb / Rd, I, vbg

    v27, I0, vbg0 = outv(T0)
    vs = [outv(t + 273.15)[0] for t in (-40, 0, 27, 70, 125)]
    tc = (max(vs) - min(vs)) / (v27 * 165) * 1e6

    i_su = 0.18e-6
    itot = 3 * I0 + i_su
    power = 1.8 * itot

    # self-cascode bottom Vds in weak inversion ~ UT ln(1+rsc); saturation needs > ~4 UT
    ut0 = k_q * T0
    vds_b = ut0 * math.log(1 + rsc)
    sat = 1 - math.exp(-vds_b / ut0)
    # residual output conductance; previous design (rsc=6) gave line ~0.31 V/V
    line = 0.31 * (1.0 / 7.0) / (1.0 / (1 + rsc)) ** -1 * 1.0
    line = 0.31 * (7.0 / (1 + rsc))
    psrr = 35.5 + 20 * math.log10(0.31 / max(line, 1e-6)) * 0.5

    return n, {"vref": v27, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
